scope: Node tests of the new panel transport using the unchanged existing state reader and injected HTTP responses; no server runtime or real network request executed
contract: onMove performs one POST to explicit test origin without failover or replay
loadState reuses the existing read-only GET client
Token is obtained per operation; privileged token patterns rejected before dispatch
Current-scope guard checked around token acquisition and result delivery
Pre-dispatch timeout prevents late token from sending
Post-dispatch uncertainty requires reread and never claims rollback
Only matching receipts with providerCacheVerified false are accepted
authorizationLimit: Client token decoding only denies known privileged claims; it does not validate JWT signatures or establish authorization. Server authentication and RLS remain mandatory.
originLimit: Explicit approved origin and known production-origin blocks are safety configuration, not proof that a remote environment is disposable
limits: Panel plus client plus actual isolated runtime still needs integration testing
Browser same-origin behavior was simulated in Node, not tested against a deployed test origin
No real Supabase Auth/PostgREST/RLS or native PostgreSQL concurrency verification
No provider/cache E2E, SQL execution, DNS changes, merge, deployment or production activation
releaseHold: Until stage 10 completion, verification and separate owner approval
